CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Leonard called the meeting t0 order at 6:30 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Drew Leonard. Vice Chair Elizabeth Riddick and Commissioners
  Marni Kamins, John G. Mazza and Skylar Peak

  ALSO PRESENT: Kellan Martz. Assistant City Attorney; Yolanda Bundy. Community
  Development Director; Patricia Salazar‘ Development and Operations Manager; Tyler
  Eaton” Principal Planner; Didier Murillo. Senior Planner; Coli Turner. Planning
  Technician; Parker Davis. Media Technician; and Gail Duncan. Recording Secretary

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  The question was called and the motion carried unanimously.

  PLANNING DIRECTOR REPORT

  Community Development Director Bundy provided an update on Rebuild Center
  statistics and announced upcoming events and meetings related to recovery
  efforts.

  Chair Leonard asked for an update on Woolsey Fire rebuild deadlines.

  Principal Planner Eaton noted the City Council held a special work session on
  fifteen rebuild policy issues and staff would return to Council for approval of the
  final policy document. Policy clarifications were intended to support the rebuild
  process.

  In response to Chair Leonardt Principal Planner Eaton noted the deadline to
  submit for a planning verification was November 8, 2024 and the deadline to
  obtain building permits was November 8. 2026. He noted that the Planning
  Commission approved extensions to these deadlines for approximately twenty-
  one properties. Eligibility for fees to be waived for qualified Woolsey Fire
  property owners would expire on June 30. 2026.
